verdict.rationale: Stable's docs have a dedicated webhooks page saying users can configure webhook endpoints in the Stable Dashboard to be notified about important account events. That is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback, so the core story is met. Depth is thin: the docs tell users to poll GET /v1/locations/{id} to detect location status transitions, which suggests limited event coverage, and Slack/email alerts do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, payload schema and signature verification, retry/delivery semantics, programmatic (API) webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
